Safety.metadataDescription: Safety tips for buying and selling on Kalodeal: meet safely, avoid scams, protect your personal information, and make every local deal with confidence.
Safety.heading: Buy and Sell <highlight>Safely</highlight>
Safety.intro: Kalodeal connects people directly, so a few precautions go a long way. Here's how to keep every deal safe and simple.
Safety.reportDescription: If you encounter a suspicious listing or message, contact our support team through the contact form.

publicPlace.title: Meet in a public place
publicPlace.description: Choose a busy, well-lit location such as a mall or a police station meet-up point.

inspect.title: Inspect before you pay
inspect.description: Check the item in person and make sure it matches the listing before handing over money.

upfrontPayments.title: Avoid upfront payments
upfrontPayments.description: Never wire money or pay a deposit before seeing the item in person.

personalData.title: Protect your personal data
personalData.description: Don't share bank details, ID numbers or passwords with other users.

instincts.title: Trust your instincts
instincts.description: If a deal feels off or too good to be true, walk away.

messages.title: Keep chats on-platform
messages.description: Use Kalodeal's messaging so there's a record of your conversation.

sellerTips.photos: Take clear, honest photos and describe the item accurately.
sellerTips.payment: Don't share the item before receiving full payment.
sellerTips.meet: Meet buyers in person for cash transactions whenever possible.
sellerTips.sold: Cancel the listing immediately once the item is sold.

buyerTips.profile: Verify the seller's profile and reviews before meeting up.
buyerTips.friend: Bring a friend along when meeting a stranger for a high-value item.
buyerTips.inspect: Test or inspect electronics and appliances before paying.
buyerTips.payment: Use secure, traceable payment methods instead of cash for large amounts.
